description: This script manages Quality of Service (QoS) configurations, including network interface setup, class and rule management, and firewall rule generation for OpenWRT-based systems.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds a kernel module using insmod or modprobe, with reference counting.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network interface name for a given interface, depending on system type.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Parses and constructs iptables rules based on configuration options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Handles configuration options for interfaces and classes.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries and sets up internal data structures.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates and assigns class numbers to QoS classes.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes QoS settings for a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS setup for all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for QoS classification.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts QoS class group configuration, including iptables chains and rules.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and chains.
